en: 7. The Question on the Re-linking and Non-re-linking of Elders.
"Venerable Nāgasena, will you then be reborn?
"Enough, Great King, what is the use of asking that? Have I not already declared: 'If, Great King, I am possessed of clinging, I shall be reborn; if I am without clinging, I shall not be reborn'?"
“Suppose, great king, a certain man were to perform a service for a king.

The king, being pleased, would grant him an office, and he, endowed and possessed of that office, would enjoy himself provided with the five strands of sensual pleasure. If he were to report to the people, ‘The king does nothing for me,’ what do you think, great king? Would that man be speaking truthfully?”
“Would that man, O Great King, be acting rightly?

“In the same way, O Great King, what is the use of asking that question? Did I not already declare beforehand: ‘If I shall be with clinging, I will undergo rebirth; if I shall be without clinging, I will not undergo rebirth’?”
Thus ends the seventh dilemma, concerning the Elder’s rebirth and non-rebirth.
